create_TelegramObserver_from_config: create a TelegramObserver from a config file with token and chat_id entries
create_TelegramObserver_directly: create a TelegramObserver with a telegram bot and chat_id for experiment notifications
send_started_event: send a Telegram message when a Sacred experiment starts on a host
send_completed_event: send a Telegram message when a Sacred experiment completes with its result
send_failed_event: send a Telegram message with backtrace when a Sacred experiment fails
